entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: 'Scuse me, is—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa. Uh, hey guys...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Looks like we've all had the same idea.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you here to speak with [fName][n]as well?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, kinda...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, he's not here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He left around noon—said he was[n]meeting up with Akechi.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro said if we need to... talk about stuff,[n]we can use this place for a while.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Cool.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: [fName] asked me the other day...[n]something along the lines of whether[n]or not I'm okay with how things are.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: At first I didn't know what he was talking[n]about, but as he kept going, his words[n]started making my chest feel all tight...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I know what you mean.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And, ever since then, it's like... like[n]something isn't right in my heart[n]anymore...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have no complaints about my current[n]life—on the contrary, in fact. I am truly[n]happy with it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So, in that case... what is this inkling of[n]a feeling I have deep in my soul?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, dammit! I'm so bad at figurin' out[n]this sorta stuff.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do ya think maybe we're all runnin' away[n]from something super-important?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've been kinda wonderin' for a while[n]now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Maybe the reason [fName]'s words[n]hurt so much is 'cause he's right...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But I was too scared to admit that, for[n]some reason. That's why I pretended[n]I didn't understand what he meant...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: When I was speaking with [fName]-kun,[n]I felt like... I caught a glimpse of this[n]mysterious sight.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Something that shouldn't have[n]happened, but still... I felt like[n]I shouldn't turn away from it...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Same here!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And myself as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems that we really have lost sight of[n]something precious to us after all...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That... might be...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But... But... I'm so scared to remember[n]what it is!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If I remember... "that," I feel like my life[n]as I know it is gonna end!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, Futaba...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But, even still... I don't want to feel this[n]way anymore, either...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Me too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess that's it, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: [fName] was tryin' to tell us all[n]somethin' important, and I bet he's[n]probably still workin' on it somewhere.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't no way I'm gonna bail on him[n]just so I can keep runnin' from...[n]whatever it is.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When I had that strange experience[n]you all mentioned, I saw [fName][n]and the rest of us there together.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I want to believe the connection we[n]share here is a genuine one.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I know if we don't do something[n]soon, we're gonna lose our connection[n]with [fName]...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't ask how I know... it just feels like[n]the truth to me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I admit I am happy right now, but...[n]I just can't accept the situation as it is.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm done with trying to escape my[n]problems!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?
